title: Kiritani Haruka — An Idol's Duty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry I took so long, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Airi! H-How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The school gave us permission to continue using the rooftop for practices and streams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?! That's great.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I was worried because they didn't sound too sure about it when we talked to them before we started.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. That's why I went in expecting to have to really argue our case and do whatever we had to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But they greenlit us just like that...
It felt a kind of anti-climactic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our videos have had a great response. Especially, the one where Shizuku talks about her feelings. Maybe they thought it was great PR for the school since it received so much attention.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The fact they have a credit-based course here is probably a big selling point for them since it makes it really easy for everyone in the entertainment industry to attend.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we'll need to be more careful if we're going to continue doing this at school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The majority of the students aren't in the entertainment business, so we don't want to cause them any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right. It wouldn't be good if a lot of fans or news reporters started showing up here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may be fine now, but that doesn't mean we shouldn't keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the first thing we should probably do is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Set up a way to contact us, maybe? As it stands, people might end up coming to our school directly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need a portal for contacting us about possible job opportunities as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. If someone wants to get in touch with us and doesn't know how, they might just call the school or something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to have a phone dedicated to this, but we'll have to make do with just an email address for now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! It's really starting to feel like we're actually idols!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to work hard to make sure that phone gets lots of calls.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So other than getting that set up...
What else do we need to do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Probably a way to deal with contracts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Contracts? You mean like agreements that say we won't do any commercials for rival companies? That sort of thing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Agencies usually have lawyers on retainer to look over contracts, but we'll have to do everything ourselves for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have a certain responsibility as the ones accepting these offers too, so it's definitely something we should pay close attention to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd definitely be happy to get an offer, but we'll probably just be focusing on our videos to grow our fan base for now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, there's one more thing...
It's actually very important...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We may have experience in the industry, but as far as society is concerned, we're still minors. We're sure to run into situations where we'll need parental approval.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So we need to make sure our parents understand what we're doing too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
That's true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But don't worry about me! They haven't been against what I've done so far, so I'm sure they'll be supportive!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I haven't met her mother, but I get the feeling she and Minori are very alike.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here. When I told them about us doing streams, they basically said, Go get 'em!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My family should be supportive as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
Today's meeting got a bit heavy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay. I figured we'd need to have this discussion at some point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! I'm still brand new to all this, so I learned a lot just from today's talk!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I feel much more ready now too, so I'm actually grateful you brought it up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's going to be difficult for the four of us to handle everything, and there's no telling what will happen.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But as long as we put our heads together, I'm sure we'll figure out a way to deal with whatever comes our way.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We made the decision to freelance, so now we have to step up and take responsibility.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shall we get back to business? It's time to discuss our plans for the next stream!
